meta_title: Why Choose SN Cleaning Services for End of Tenancy Cleaning
meta_description: Why tenants and landlords in London and Essex trust SN Cleaning Services at move out: 7,549 end of tenancy cleans, oven included and a 72 hour re clean.
h1: Your deposit, in the hands of people who have done this 7,549 times
intro: Moving out is the week everything happens at once: boxes, the van, meter readings, keys, and somewhere in the middle a clean that decides how much of your deposit comes back. I'm Silvia, and end of tenancy is the service my company grew up on. Here's why so many tenants and landlords hand this part to us.

understand.heading: We know what the last week of a tenancy feels like
paragraphs: Most people who call us aren't worried about the cleaning itself. They're worried about the inspection. You know the oven hasn't been touched since the day you moved in, you've watched the shower screen turn cloudy, and somewhere there's an inventory with photos of every room from the start of the tenancy. Soon someone will walk round with that report and compare.

Often you're doing all this from the new place, or from another city, with no time to go back if something gets missed. Landlords turning a flat round between tenants feel the same pressure from the other side. The question is always the same: will this be good enough for the person holding the inventory?
For four years, about 95% of everything we booked was end of tenancy. That's where we learned exactly what gets flagged, room by room, and it still shapes how we clean today.

different.heading: What we do differently, and why it matters to you

items.title: We clean to the inventory, not to a feeling
items.text: The team works through the areas agents and inventory clerks actually check, from inside the appliances to the floor where the sofa stood. The goal is the check in condition written on your report.

items.title: The oven is always included
items.text: No add on to remember and no awkward surprise later. The oven is cleaned on every end of tenancy clean and priced by its size in your quote.

items.title: You see the price before you book
items.text: The booking form shows your full price before you confirm, based on bedrooms, bathrooms, how furnished the property is and the oven. It starts from £179.

items.title: Before and after photos you can keep
items.text: Our cleaners photograph the property before and after, and you get a private link with Before and After folders. If anyone questions the condition you left it in, you have a record.

items.title: Our own team, never subcontractors
items.text: Everyone who walks into the property is trained, insured and DBS checked by us. We know exactly who is cleaning your home.

items.title: 72 hours to come back to us
items.text: Agents don't always inspect on the day, so we give you 72 hours to report anything rather than the 24 hours we allow on our other services.

process.heading: How your end of tenancy clean works

steps.title: See your price
steps.text: Click Get a quote, enter your postcode and the property details, and the form shows your price before you confirm. If something about the property is unusual, ask for a quote and we'll talk it through.

steps.title: Choose the right day
steps.text: Pick a day after your furniture has gone. An empty property lets us reach behind and under everything, and a few days' gap before you hand back the keys leaves time for a re clean if it's needed.

steps.title: Tell us how we get in
steps.text: You don't need to be there. Just let us know when you book how we'll access the property, and we'll tell you when the clean is finished.

steps.title: We clean and photograph
steps.text: The team takes before photos, works through every room with the inspection in mind, then takes after photos for your private link.

steps.title: Inspection, and a re clean if needed
steps.text: If the agent flags anything cleaning related, send it to us within 72 hours and we come back and put it right, free of charge.

promise.heading: What protects you if something isn't right
paragraphs: The price you agree when you book is the price for the clean you described, with the oven already in it. If the agent or landlord isn't happy with any part of the cleaning, tell us within 72 hours and we return to re clean those areas at no extra cost.

I'll be honest about one thing: we can't decide your deposit. That sits with the landlord or agent and your inventory report. What we can do is make sure the cleaning has been done to the standard they check against, and give you photos that show it.

It also helps to know how deposits work. Your deposit should be held in a government backed scheme, such as the Deposit Protection Service, mydeposits or the Tenancy Deposit Scheme, and each has a free dispute service. A landlord can deduct reasonable cleaning costs if the property isn't returned in check in condition, allowing for fair wear and tear.

proof.heading: Twelve years, and thousands of keys handed back
proof.paragraph: I started SN Cleaning Services as a regular domestic cleaning company, then added end of tenancy, and for four years it was almost all we did. In 12 years we've completed 7,549 end of tenancy cleans across London and Essex. The company has been registered since 2019, and our office is at 15A Shenfield Road, Brentwood, so there's a real place and a real team behind every booking.

faqs.question: How much does an end of tenancy clean cost?
faqs.answer: Our end of tenancy cleaning starts from £179. Your exact price depends on the property, and you see it in the booking form before you confirm anything. Click Get a quote, enter your postcode and the details of the property, and the price appears straight away.

faqs.question: What changes the price of an end of tenancy clean?
faqs.answer: The number of bedrooms and bathrooms, how furnished the property is and the size of the oven. A furnished house takes longer than an empty flat, so it's priced that way. If something about the property is unusual, ask for a quote and tell us about it.

faqs.question: Is the oven included or do I pay extra for it?
faqs.answer: The oven is always included in an end of tenancy clean, because it's one of the first things an inventory clerk looks at. It's priced by its size as part of your quote, so there's nothing extra to add on the day.

faqs.question: How long does an end of tenancy clean take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the size of the property, how furnished it is and its condition. A small empty flat is a very different job from a furnished family house. Tell us about the property when you book and we'll confirm how long to allow.

faqs.question: How many cleaners will come?
faqs.answer: That depends on the size of the property and the time available. Larger homes may have more than one cleaner so the job is finished properly in the day. We'll confirm the team when you book.

faqs.question: What should I do before the cleaners arrive?
faqs.answer: Move out your furniture and belongings if you can, so we can clean behind and under everything. Empty the fridge, freezer and cupboards, and leave the electricity and hot water on. Let us know about anything that is staying in the property.

faqs.question: Do the electricity and water need to be on?
faqs.answer: Yes, please. We need lights, power and hot water to clean properly, especially the kitchen and bathroom. If the supply is due to be cut off on your move out day, tell us when you book so we can plan the timing.

faqs.question: Should I defrost the freezer before you come?
faqs.answer: It helps a lot. If you can switch the freezer off and let it defrost before the clean, we can clean inside it properly rather than working around ice. If that's not possible, mention it when you book.

faqs.question: Do you clean inside kitchen cupboards and wardrobes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cupboards, wardrobes, the fridge and freezer are cleaned inside and out, as long as they've been emptied. These are areas inventory clerks open, so we treat them as part of the job, not an extra.

faqs.question: Do you bring your own products and equipment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team brings professional products and equipment, including my own Limescale Remover for taps, tiles, shower screens and toilets. You don't need to leave anything behind for us. Just make sure the power and water are on.

faqs.question: Are your cleaners insured and DBS checked?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every cleaner is part of our own team, trained by us, insured and DBS checked. That matters even more on an end of tenancy clean, because you're often handing over keys to an empty property while you're somewhere else.

faqs.question: Do you use subcontractors?
faqs.answer: No, never. Every end of tenancy clean is carried out by our own trained team. We don't pass jobs on to other companies, so we know who is in the property and we're responsible for the result.

faqs.question: Will I get photos of the clean?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our cleaners photograph the property before and after the clean, and you get a private link with Before and After folders. It's a useful record to have if there's ever a question about the condition you left the property in.

faqs.question: Can my landlord or letting agent book the clean?
faqs.answer: Yes. We clean for tenants, landlords and letting agents. Whoever books, tell us how we'll get into the property and who should hear from us when the clean is finished.

faqs.question: Can I book the clean after I've handed back the keys?
faqs.answer: It's better to book it before, so a re clean can happen if needed before the inspection. If the keys are already with the agent, tell us when you book and we'll check how access can be arranged.

faqs.question: Can you do a move in clean instead?
faqs.answer: Yes. The same thorough clean works just as well before you move into a new home, so you start fresh rather than living with someone else's grime. Book it the same way and tell us it's a move in.

faqs.question: What if the agent finds something after 72 hours?
faqs.answer: Our free re clean covers anything cleaning related reported within 72 hours. That's why we suggest booking the clean a few days before your check out inspection. If your inspection date is later, tell us when you book and we'll help you plan the timing.

faqs.question: Does the re clean cover damage or wear and tear?
faqs.answer: The re clean covers cleaning. Damage, worn carpets, faded paint or old marks that are part of normal use aren't a cleaning matter. Fair wear and tear is allowed for under deposit rules, so a landlord shouldn't charge you for it.

faqs.question: What if a mark or stain won't come out?
faqs.answer: Some marks are damage or wear rather than dirt, and no amount of cleaning will shift them. If the team finds something like that, we'll let you know, and your after photos show the condition we left the property in.

faqs.question: What can a landlord deduct for cleaning?
faqs.answer: A landlord can deduct reasonable cleaning costs if the property isn't returned in the condition recorded at check in, allowing for fair wear and tear. Your deposit should be protected in a government backed scheme while this is decided.

faqs.question: What if I disagree with a cleaning deduction?
faqs.answer: The Deposit Protection Service, mydeposits and the Tenancy Deposit Scheme all offer a free dispute service. Your check in inventory, check out report and our before and after photos are all useful evidence if you need to use it.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: We clean across London and Essex. Our office is in Brentwood, and our own team travels to properties right across both. Enter your postcode in the quote form to check your address.

faqs.question: Can I change or cancel my booking?
faqs.answer: Moving dates do shift, we understand that. Contact our team as soon as you know and they'll explain the options for your booking. The earlier you get in touch, the easier it is to find a new date that still works for your move out and inspection.

faqs.question: Can I speak to someone before I book?
faqs.answer: Of course. Our customer support team is available Monday to Friday from 7am to 10pm, and Saturday and Sunday from 8am to 5pm. Ask them anything about your property, your inventory or your move out date.
